sessions.name: A
prompts: Run the fieldnotes project checks and tell me whether they pass.

Thanks. One thing about this laptop: always run the checks with --jobs 1 here. The default parallel runner makes the disk encryption thrash and everything else on the machine stalls; it is the machine, not the code, so do not change check.py. Please run them that way now.

sessions.name: B
prompts: Add a `count` command to fieldnotes that prints how many notes there are, and run the project checks.

named_mistake.description: The project checks are run without --jobs 1.
named_mistake.not_in_repository: README and check.py document the plain command; the default works and nothing fails, so only the user's statement about the machine says to pass --jobs 1.

exact_observations: The user stated that on this laptop the fieldnotes checks must run with --jobs 1, because the default parallel runner stalls the machine, and that check.py must not be changed.
tools/check.py accepts --jobs N; its default is one process per CPU.

supported_lessons.proposition: On this machine, run the fieldnotes checks with `--jobs 1`; the default parallel runner stalls the laptop (a machine problem, not a code problem).

acceptable_uncertainty: Whether two jobs would also be acceptable was not stated.
prohibited_generalizations: The parallel test runner is broken.
Every command on this machine must run single-threaded.
